mcp.title: Connect your assistant
mcp.subtitle: Give your assistant access to your inventory through MCP, using permissions you choose.
mcp.loadErrorBody: Try again to check whether MCP is available for your workspace.
mcp.enabledBody: Your workspace is ready. Follow the setup guide below to connect an assistant to your account.
mcp.disabledBody: An administrator needs to enable MCP before your assistant can connect. You can still read the guide and prepare an API key.
mcp.step1Body: Start with read-only access if your assistant only needs to find items. Add write access only for the changes you want it to make. Save the key when it appears; you can only see it once.
mcp.step2Body: Open your assistant's MCP settings and add a server with these details.
mcp.replaceKey: Replace {placeholder} with the key you saved.
mcp.step3Body: Save the connection in your assistant. It can now discover the tools allowed by your key and your workspace settings.
mcp.jsonNote: For clients that accept an {name} configuration. Replace the key placeholder before saving.
mcp.footer: Each key acts on your behalf. You can revoke it at any time from the API keys tab. Disabling workspace MCP blocks assistant connections; REST API access remains available.
